metadata.short_desc: Safe, auditable user profile memory with a WebUI panel.
metadata.desc: Profile Weaver maintains user profiles under a strict "current speaker only" rule: the LLM writes through explicit tools and must quote evidence from the message, backed by an identity guard, a field denylist and a full audit trail. Ships with a Dashboard panel (7 themes), import/export, daily backups and restore, profile merging and statistics.

profiles.title: Profile Weaver
profiles.desc: Browse, edit, export and back up every user profile.

session_based.hint: Off: one shared profile per user across chats. On: each group or private chat keeps its own profile.

default_fields.hint: Global base fields. The LLM and user commands can still create per-user custom fields. More fields means a longer injected prompt; keep "备注" (notes) last.

llm_write_denylist.description: Fields the LLM may not write
llm_write_denylist.hint: These fields can only be maintained by user commands or admins; LLM tools and auto-extraction are rejected. Good place for sensitive fields.

max_notes_count.hint: The notes field keeps only the most recent N entries; older ones are dropped.

llm_tools_enabled.hint: Off: the LLM can read profile context but cannot modify profiles.

proactive_extraction_enabled.hint: On: runs one very short background tool loop only when the message looks like an explicit self-description and no profile tool was used in the main turn. Costs a few extra tokens.

proactive_extraction_min_message_length.description: Minimum message length for auto extraction
proactive_extraction_min_message_length.hint: Shorter messages never trigger auto extraction.

proactive_extraction_max_message_length.description: Maximum message length for auto extraction
proactive_extraction_max_message_length.hint: Longer messages are skipped to control token cost and false positives.

proactive_extraction_max_steps.description: Max tool steps for auto extraction
proactive_extraction_max_steps.hint: Keep this at 1-2; more steps cost more tokens.

allow_llm_custom_fields.description: Let the LLM create custom fields
allow_llm_custom_fields.hint: On: the LLM may create per-user fields when the base fields are not enough.

allow_user_custom_fields.description: Let users create custom fields via commands
allow_user_custom_fields.hint: Off: "设置画像" can only update existing fields.

strict_identity_guard.hint: On: if the message clearly refers to someone else without a clear self-statement, LLM tools refuse to write.

evidence_match_mode.hint: strict: evidence must appear verbatim in the message; normalized: ignores whitespace and CJK/ASCII punctuation differences (recommended); loose: only requires enough key-fragment overlap.

custom_field_name_max_length.hint: Keep it short so the LLM does not create overly granular fields.

field_value_max_length.hint: Longer values are truncated so chat transcripts do not end up in the profile.

allow_profile_in_group.description: Allow viewing your profile in group chats
allow_profile_in_group.hint: Off: viewing a profile in a group chat is rejected to reduce privacy leaks.

group_profile_denied_msg.description: Message shown when group viewing is denied

profile_prompt_template.description: Profile prompt template injected into the LLM

inject_when_empty.description: Inject the full prompt even when the profile is empty
inject_when_empty.hint: Off: injects only a short note while the user has no profile yet, saving a lot of tokens.

webui_enabled.hint: Off: no Web API is registered and the Dashboard page cannot read or write data. Requires a plugin reload.

webui_allow_edit.description: Allow write operations from the WebUI
webui_allow_edit.hint: Off: the WebUI becomes read-only — no field edits, deletes, merges, imports or backup restores.

webui_default_theme.hint: The browser remembers the theme you pick manually; this is only the first-visit default.

export_mask_user_ids.description: Mask user IDs on export by default
export_mask_user_ids.hint: On: user IDs and names are masked in exports. Masked files are for inspection only and cannot be imported back.

audit_log_max_mb.hint: Rotates into a timestamped history file once exceeded so the audit log cannot grow forever.

backup_retention_days.hint: A snapshot is taken on the first write of each day; backups older than this are cleaned up. 0 disables cleanup.

debug_log_level.hint: DEBUG logs more tool calls and identity-guard decisions.
